setup.description: Fast chat mode (first answer) as sold: the HYBRID_COMPLETION recall plus exactly one Quote selection picker call (ADR 0006). Next-tier search and the UI quoted-answer composer are deliberately out of scope.
setup.contract_change: The original baseline contract — the streamed prose rendered as the phase-1 answer, no picker, recorded at commit b051e82 on feat/12-cognee-postgres-avalai — is SUPERSEDED as of 2026-09-12 by the Quote selection (ADR 0006, issue #28/#29): the sold first answer is the HYBRID_COMPLETION recall plus exactly one glm-5.3-flash picker call on the sheet server (ui/serve.py /quote-selection, guarded 4-12 sentences). The baseline runs recorded under the old contract are archived at runs/archive/baseline/ (not deleted); from this re-record on, the recorded baseline measures the product as sold.

mode_under_test.name: fast chat (first answer)
mode_under_test.stream_note: Benchmark calls non-streaming; the UI streams the same call and the final frame carries the identical JSON, so total wall time is comparable. TTFT is a UI-side metric and is not benchmarked here.

quote_selection.pool: the recall's Evidence block parsed exactly as the sheet parses it — bullets `locator: "passage"`
quote_selection.selection_guard: verbatim letter-stream guard; survivors cap at 12, below 4 answers [] — the recorded prose fallback
quote_selection.gate: a phone with at least one chat today — the bootstrap ask records the chat; the picker never records or counts one
quote_selection.benchmark_phone: 09120000000 (reserved for runs; bootstrapped with one real ask before a run)

excluded_modes: Next-tier search: cognee-next-tier, port 8001, GRAPH_COMPLETION_COT, glm-5.3
Quoted-answer composer (UI phase 2): planner+writer glm-5.3-flash calls in ui/serve.py

dataset.name: tarhe-kolli
dataset.book: طرح کلی اندیشۀ اسلامی در قرآن

setup.dataset_note: TKI questions target tarhe-kolli and the benchmark payload stays on that dataset alone so runs stay comparable. The Book set itself is two Books since 2026-09-10 (added: انسان ۲۵۰ ساله, dataset 70143-336, chunk_size 3500; tarhe-kolli re-ingested at chunk_size 4100). The baseline runs recorded under the old contract (runs/archive/baseline/20260910T180829Z) predate that change: they ran on text-embedding-3-small at 1536 dims with the 4096 default chunk size.

patches.docker/enable_farsi_evidence.py: Compose entrypoint patch: Farsi-aware overlap regex (keeps Farsi terms, not only [a-z0-9]) and snippet window widened to 600 chars (Cognee default 160) so quoted passages hold complete sentences.
